steps.title: Separate operating and protective paths

steps.title: Separate overload and short circuit

steps.simple: Suitably designed fuses/MCBs go in the proper live path; residual-current protection has a distinct role. A2kW oven at 220 V draws 9.09 A, beyond5 A. Merely fitting a larger device does not make unsuitable wiring safe.
